items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses meeting Albert and working with Banks. Guy Kelly is mentioned only by the interviewer ('Yes, he once recorded with a band, Guy Kelly.') and the interviewee does not confirm any personal interaction or relationship with Kelly, instead continuing to discuss Banks.

ctx.x: Oh, I met him in the 30s. In the 30s. Oh, yeah. Yeah. I met Albert... must have been around 34, 35. And he also had a band. Yeah. No, he was with Banks. He worked with a drummer by the name of Banks. Did you meet him with a drummer? Nah, he didn't ever have a band. I guess he did have a band later. I guess he did.
Yes, he once recorded with a band, Guy Kelly.

Well, he did most of his work though with this fellow Banks, because Banks had the band, the drummer. Yeah. Yeah. I don't know. They used to... What do you know about Clarence Jones? Well, I only knew him through his work. I went to see him one time when he was, uh, over in Detroit over there, you know. And I knew him over the family. I never did... we never did... well, so just like personal friends like that. Yeah. I only just met him through... a musician took me over there and I went over there and... He was…
